function.name: move_to
function.arguments: {"targets": {"z": 0.85, "gripper": 0}, "note": "The previous pure-pose calls only advance a couple of control steps, while calls that flip the gripper latch execute the full motion. The gripper is open and the gripper state is good (cube between the pads), so I combine the latch flip with the descent: the jaws close just above the block and then settle around it as the hand lowers to z=0.85."}
